_key.description: Genomic element key, strand token, source file accession and biosample term joined by underscores.

bed_score.title: BED Score
bed_score.description: Score column of the source BED file.

strand.title: Strand
strand.description: Strand the tile was tested in..

enum_descriptions.+: Forward strand of the reference sequence.
enum_descriptions.-: Reverse strand of the reference sequence.
Strand is not recorded or is not applicable.

log2FC.title: Log2 Fold Change
log2FC.description: Fold change in reporter activity for the element: its normalized output (RNA) over input (DNA) ratio.

DNA_count.title: DNA Count
DNA_count.description: Input count (DNA), normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

RNA_count.title: RNA Count
RNA_count.description: Output count (RNA), normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.title: Adjusted Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Adjusted negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction
neg_log10_pvalue_adj.threshold: Used for significant when available: >= 1, equivalent to adjusted p-value/q-value <= 0.1.

significant.title: Significant?
significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the element's activity.
significant.threshold: The adapter sets significant to true when neg_log10_pvalue_adj is available and >= 1 (adjusted p-value/q-value <= 0.1); otherwise false. The unadjusted neg_log10_pvalue is not a fallback. This labels significance and does not filter out nonsignificant rows.
